_comment: Capture manifest for live-tenant screenshots embedded in the generated guides,
url         -> absolute, or a path resolved against tenantUrl
placeholder -> matched against the existing screenshot('...') description strings in
gen-setup-guide.js / gen-creation-guide.js so those 31 call sites need
no edits. Match is on a normalized substring, not exact equality.
waitFor     -> optional CSS selector to wait for before capturing
skip        -> true when the screen does not exist in this tenant yet; the generators
fall back to the original text callout via their fs.existsSync guard.
